content: पूर् I. €4 <ab>Ā.</ab> (पूर्यते, पूर्ण) .²1 To fill, fill out (allied in this sense with <ab>pass.</ab> of पॄ <ab>q. v.</ab>). .²2 To please, satisfy. --II. €10 <ab>U.</ab> (पूरयति-ते, पूरित; strictly the {%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} of पॄ <ab>q. v.</ab>) .²1 To fill; को न याति वशं लोके मुखे पिण्डेन पूरितः <ls>Bh. 2. 118</ls>; <ls>Śi. 9. 64</ls>, <ls n="Śi.">16. 34</ls>. .²2 To blow into or fill with wind, blow (as a conchshell). .²3 To cover, surround; पूरयन्तः समाजग्मुर्भयदाया दिशो दश <ls>Bk. 7. 30</ls>. .²4 To fulfil, satisfy; पूरयतु कुतूहलं वत्सः <ls>U. 4</ls>; so आशाम्, मनोरथम् <ab>&c.</ab> .²5 To intensify, strengthen (as sound). .²6 To make resonant. .²7 To load or enrich with (gifts <ab>&c.</ab>). .²8 To draw (as a bow). .²9 To spend (time).
